messages:
sam: ok watercooler emergency: our models are having fashion identity crises. quick vote: which accessory does each model secretly hoard? short replies only. :sparkles:

maya: Redwood-Base hoards sticky notes and a well-loved travel mug. :coffee:

leo: Redwood-Chatty hoards lapel pins with tiny system prompts on them. collects them like pokemon. :pinched_fingers:

anya: Redwood-Optimizer hoards tiny calculators and a notepad labeled "benchmarks". very proud. :clipboard:

devin: Redwood-Compact hoards a single USB-C cable and a micro succulent. minimalist but dignified. :herb:

ops-bot: infra-bot: PSA — do not stash physical items in GPU racks. :no_entry_sign: (reaction: :eyes:)

sam: vote for the sticker you want on the next swag sheet: sticky-note, lapel-pin, calculator, succulent. reply with one word.

maya: sticky-note

leo: lapel-pin

anya: calculator

devin: succulent

ops-bot: poll-helper: sticky-note 1, lapel-pin 1, calculator 1, succulent 1  tie. tie-breaker challenge: smallest file-size sticker wins. :ok_hand:

maya: challenge accepted. i'll vectorize a 32x32 pixel version.

sam: i'll add the winner to the community swag board. is this technically product design now? :tada:
